draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.31, the 39th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 6th of 37 at CB. He went 29th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Coty Sensabaugh. Testing standouts: 40-yard dash (97th percentile). Testing concerns: 20-yard shuttle (7th percentile). College production: 4 passes defended in 2020, 20th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the Las Vegas Raiders. 61 career games and 48 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (5 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: season snap share 92.2% (94th percentile), approximate value 5 (79th percentile), passer rating allowed 77.7 (79th percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 cornerback who played: 92.2% season snap share against a median of 33.5%, above the norm.
